title: Things I Want To Do With You
human_truth: Love becomes most sendable when it names ordinary futures people quietly want with their person.
emotional_obstacle: The reference format is highly romantic but risks becoming generic wish-list content if the visuals only decorate the text.
aachu_proof: Aachu is present through hands, jewelry, hair silhouette, bedding, coffee, balcony warmth, and the objects Zuv keeps noticing for her.
zuv_active_role: Zuv does not simply appear beside the wish; he drives, reaches, notices, saves objects, serves food, and collects the moments with her.
proof_engine: Every slide turns a poetic wish into a staged small action: hands lifting, mugs held, spoons meeting, hands held in a car, dinner served, object chosen, memories gathered.
emotional_arc: open wish -> domestic ease -> playful date abundance -> ordinary errand intimacy -> shared-home future -> private noticing -> collected moments payoff
visual_system: A Story watercolor-and-ink little-future vignettes with cinematic crops, soft negative space, and selective identity visibility.
publish_note: If publishing publicly, confirm permission for exact copied text or switch to the rewrite options in copy.json.

successful_carousel_standard.audience_success: A cold viewer sends it to their partner as a quiet list of ordinary futures they want together.
successful_carousel_standard.creative_success: The viewer can understand each beat from staged hands, objects, posture, and setting even before reading the text.
successful_carousel_standard.brand_success: The reference mood becomes A Story of Two: warm, observational, illustrated, tender, and behavior-led rather than stock-photo romance.
successful_carousel_standard.production_success: Every slide is feasible in native 4:5 and native 9:16 with generous negative space and no face requirement on every post.
